home.eyebrow: A grow journal for personal growers
home.title: The grow journal that remembers every run.
home.intro: Stop piecing together phone photos, feeding notes, and calendar reminders. Keep a grow history you can use to repeat what worked — the way serious growers do. Get AI help when you need it. Free to start.

sections.title: Personal growers
sections.body: Keep tasks, feeds, readings, and photos in one grow timeline so you can look back at what changed. Your run's lessons survive to the next run, so you can repeat what worked instead of guessing between harvests.

sections.title: Commercial creators
sections.body: Keep product trials and grow results together, then share what you know through courses, eligible storefront products, and live sessions.

sections.title: Facilities
sections.body: Compliance records in METRC, but daily room notes scattered across messages and spreadsheets? Keep readings, tasks, SOP checklists, and handoffs together for each room in GrowPathAI. This does not replace your required compliance system.

features.title: Tools appear where the work happens
features.intro: The Tools page is a library. GrowPathAI also launches the same tools from grows, plants, logs, tasks, photos, harvests, courses, and facility workspaces.

sections.title: Plan and schedule
sections.body: Start-a-grow planning, grow calendars, watering, feeding, timelines, and recurring tasks create real work items.

sections.title: Observe and diagnose
sections.body: Journal entries, photos, environmental history, plant diagnosis, IPM review, and harvest-readiness results stay connected to the grow timeline.

sections.title: Learn and share
sections.body: Courses, live sessions, forums, feeds, and public creator pages connect education with documented grow workflows.

pricing.title: Start free and keep what you create
pricing.intro: All GrowPathAI users can create and publish free or paid courses, including users on the Free plan. Paid plans add higher limits and advanced workspace features. Priced by what you do, not per seat: one Facility subscription covers its team workspace, with shared plan limits.

sections.title: Free
sections.body: Track 1 grow and 1 plant, with 5 AI credits each week. Keep a journal and use core grow tools. All plans can create and publish courses within their plan limits.

sections.title: Pro Grower — $10/month or $100/year
sections.body: For growers who need more room: 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 AI credits each week. Annual billing is charged as one $100 payment; save $20 compared with 12 monthly payments.

sections.title: Commercial — $50/month or $500/year
sections.body: For brands and sellers: 50 grows, 500 plants, and 500 AI credits each week, plus storefront, course, campaign, inventory, and trial workflows. Annual billing is charged as one $500 payment; save $100 compared with 12 monthly payments.

sections.title: Facility — $100/month or $1,000/year
sections.body: For room-based team work: 200 grows, 2,000 plants, and a shared Facility pool of 2,000 AI credits each week. Annual billing is charged as one $1,000 payment; save $200 compared with 12 monthly payments.

personal-grower.title: A grow journal that helps decide what comes next
personal-grower.intro: Take your growing seriously without hunting through notebooks and camera rolls. Keep your feeding schedule, photos, readings, and finished tasks in one timeline, so this run's lessons survive to the next run and you can repeat what worked.

sections.title: Grow your way
sections.body: Support for tents, rooms, greenhouses, containers, raised beds, hydroponics, living soil, fruit trees, vegetables, flowers, and other selected interests.

sections.title: Context-aware help
sections.body: Ask AI from a grow, plant, log, task, or photo so the relevant stage and recent history can travel with the question.

sections.title: Keep a useful record
sections.body: Review what you fed, what you saw, and what you changed so you can repeat what worked and remember what you would do differently. Keep the results attached to the run, then export supported timelines and reports for your own records.

commercial-cultivation.title: Cultivation evidence with business context
commercial-cultivation.intro: Keep product information, trials, and grow records together, then review what you want customers or learners to see. Commercial brings seller and creator work into the same plan.

sections.title: Trials and formulas
sections.body: Connect recipes, batches, grow trials, and evidence runs to the product line they support. A saved calculation or trial observation does not establish a product-performance claim; review the evidence before using it publicly.

sections.title: Selling products or downloads?
sections.body: Start with a saved draft, review its description, price, and delivery setup, then explicitly publish. Public presentation and payment readiness are separate checks; a Commercial subscription does not make every product eligible for checkout.

sections.title: Teaching or hosting?
sections.body: Connect courses, live sessions, and Forum Q&A to your public business presence. Use Feed campaigns for reviewed promotions and Forum discussions for questions and help. Course publication includes media review; hosted broadcasting uses an encoder such as OBS and the available hosting allowance.

sections.title: What does Commercial include?
sections.body: Commercial is $50/month or $500/year, with 50 grows, 500 plants, and 500 AI credits each week. Seller payment setup, eligible products, and reviewed publication are still required. Team assignment, formal SOP control, and Facility audit workflows belong to Facility.

facility-management.title: Facility → Room → Grow → Plant
facility-management.intro: Compliance records in METRC, daily operations in scattered messages? See what needs doing in each room, assign it to the right person, and review the recorded result in GrowPathAI. It does not replace your required compliance system or certify compliance.

sections.title: Roles that match responsibility
sections.body: Set up the selected Facility, rooms, and team memberships, then use owner, manager, staff, and viewer roles to match access to the work. Each person keeps their individual account and enters the shared workspace through their Facility membership.

sections.title: Operational records
sections.body: Assign recurring work, run reviewed SOP checklists, and record inventory usage with the selected Facility. The authorized team member records the work; the manager can return to the task, journal evidence, and completion history. Recorded completion is not automatic compliance certification.

sections.title: Environmental context
sections.body: Review imported controller history alongside the room and grow it belongs to. AC Infinity and Bluelab CSV history are import workflows, not a promise of live device control. Check supported provider setup before connecting equipment.

sections.title: What does the team need to start?
sections.body: An owner sets up the Facility subscription and invites the team. Facility is $100/month or $1,000/year for 200 grows, 2,000 plants, and a shared pool of 2,000 AI credits each week. One subscription covers the team workspace within those shared limits; it is not priced per seat.

nurseries-breeders.title: Track plants, propagation, and selection decisions
nurseries-breeders.intro: Keep plant photos, observations, and follow-up work connected to the grow that produced them. Choose Commercial for product and education work, or Facility when a team needs shared assignments and operational records.

sections.title: Propagation
sections.body: Keep mother-plant, clone and tissue-culture checks connected to their source records. Attach photos, plan follow-up work and document observations within the supported crop and workspace context. Recorded counts and direct inspections matter; elapsed time or a photo alone does not establish successful propagation.

sections.title: Selection
sections.body: Keep genetics notes, phenotype scores, stress and recovery records, and harvest observations available for selection and run comparisons. Record the evidence and reasoning behind a decision; incomplete observations do not establish a cultivar guarantee or a winning run.

sections.title: Keep the observation with the plant
sections.body: Record what you saw, attach owned photos, and schedule the next check. Missing measurements stay unknown; a photograph or elapsed time does not prove successful propagation. Crop-specific tools depend on the selected crop and eligible workspace context.

sections.title: Choose the workspace for the job
sections.body: Commercial connects product lines, trials, and education. Facility adds shared rooms, staff assignments, reviewed SOPs, and operational history. Decide whether you need an individual business record or a team handoff before choosing a plan.

sections.title: Education and profiles
sections.body: Review the exact material before publishing a course or public profile. Private grow and Facility records remain private. A published profile or subscription does not establish product eligibility, transaction permission, or a verified growing outcome.

grow-stores.title: Products, education, and community in one public presence
grow-stores.intro: Show customers the offer you have reviewed, with its description, price, and supported next step. Keep owner drafts, published products, and the customer's buying or download experience distinct.

sections.title: Storefront
sections.body: Organize product lines, product pages, links, inventory context, and public brand information. Review the saved public presentation and publish when ready. Storefront Offers keeps downloadable offers in a separate draft-and-publish workflow. The example above shows owner controls, not a live shopping cart.

sections.title: Education
sections.body: Explain how a product fits a growing workflow through reviewed courses or live education. Use Forum Q&A for customer questions and Feed campaigns for reviewed promotions. Keep supporting trial records connected, and qualify claims to the evidence you actually have.

sections.title: What is needed before a customer can buy?
sections.body: Complete seller payment setup and the product's price, publication, and delivery requirements. A paid download needs an active private file you own. Publishing alone does not verify payment readiness or permit every transaction; product and buyer eligibility still apply.

sections.title: Commercial plan fit
sections.body: Commercial is $50/month or $500/year, with 50 grows, 500 plants, and 500 AI credits each week alongside storefront and creator workflows. Sales, earnings, and customer demand are not guaranteed.

creators-educators.title: Publish courses on every plan
creators-educators.intro: Give learners a course they can follow and viewers a place to find your sessions. All users can create and publish free or paid courses within plan limits; Commercial adds business and storefront workflows.

sections.title: Build from real work
sections.body: Use grow timelines, logs, photos, recipes, tool results, and forum answers you own or have permission to share as course source material. Prepare a private draft, add lessons, and review the learner-facing preview before publishing. Selecting a private grow record never publishes it automatically.

sections.title: Teach live
sections.body: Schedule and explicitly publish a session so eligible viewers can RSVP and use in-app reminders. For GrowPath-hosted broadcasts, use OBS or another compatible encoder for cameras, microphones, and scenes; GrowPath provides the session, player, and chat. Check your hosting allowance and setup before broadcasting.

sections.title: What must be ready before publication?
sections.body: For lessons with video, review media rights, availability, captions or transcript status, a written learner summary, and a fallback link. Video is optional; text lessons are supported too. Paid courses also need a positive saved price and verified seller payment readiness. A course preview does not purchase or enroll a learner.

sections.title: When does Commercial fit?
sections.body: Choose Commercial when your teaching also needs storefront and business records: $50/month or $500/year, with 50 grows, 500 plants, and 500 weekly AI credits. Compare course, lesson, and hosting limits before choosing.

about.title: Software for clearer cultivation decisions
about.intro: GrowPathAI is designed to connect planning, observation, analysis, work, learning, and documentation without forcing users to hunt through disconnected tools.

sections.title: One shared engine
sections.body: Contextual tool launches create reusable results that can feed logs, tasks, timelines, reports, and lessons.

sections.title: Many grow types
sections.body: Recommendations and discovery follow user grow interests instead of assuming every grow is the same crop or environment.

sections.title: Human decisions
sections.body: AI assists with questions and structured analysis; users remain responsible for reviewing information and choosing actions.

sections.title: Creator applications

sections.title: Security and safety

ai-cultivation-disclaimer.title: AI is decision support, not a guarantee
ai-cultivation-disclaimer.intro: GrowPathAI can organize context, calculate values, identify patterns, and suggest questions or next steps. Its output may be incomplete or wrong and must be reviewed.

sections.title: Cultivation
sections.body: Confirm diagnoses and treatments using direct observation, labels, trusted references, testing, and qualified local professionals.

sections.title: Safety and compliance
sections.body: Follow product labels, workplace procedures, local laws, licensing rules, and environmental and food-safety requirements.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body: Avoid entering secrets or unnecessary personal information. Review what grow, plant, photo, and account context is attached before submitting.

vs/plntrk.title: GrowPathAI and PLNTRK: compare the work you need to do
vs/plntrk.intro: Both keep grow records and offer AI help. Choose by your plant count, day-to-day logging, export needs, and whether you also need courses, storefront work, or a facility workspace.

sections.title: PLNTRK: plant-first tracking
sections.body: PLNTRK's published Pro plans include plant photos, logs, AI help, and QR/NFC logging. Pro 25 is $35/year for up to 25 plants; Pro 100 is $90/year for up to 100 plants. Check its checkout for current prices and terms.

sections.title: GrowPathAI: a grow record connected to your next task
sections.body: Start Free with 1 grow, 1 plant, and 5 AI credits per week. Pro Grower is $10/month or $100/year for 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 weekly AI credits. Commercial and Facility plans cover different business and team workflows.

sections.title: Can I export my records?
sections.body: PLNTRK documents CSV grow-data exports and a plant PDF with photos and logs. GrowPathAI offers supported timeline/report exports plus an account-export request in Profile privacy controls. Check the export you need before committing a season of records.
sections.linkLabel: Source: PLNTRK export and privacy FAQ

sections.title: Where does my data live?
sections.body: These are cloud-backed services, not a guarantee of local-only storage. PLNTRK's FAQ describes cloud backup. GrowPathAI's Terms say you retain ownership of your content; its Privacy page explains processing and export/deletion requests.

sections.title: Is GrowPathAI always the cheaper choice?
sections.body: No. PLNTRK's advertised Pro 25 annual price is lower than GrowPathAI Pro Grower. Compare the plant limit and workflows you will actually use, not just a feature count. This comparison is written by GrowPathAI, not an independent review.

grow-journal-app.title: Keep the details you will want next run
grow-journal-app.intro: A useful grow journal puts feeds, photos, readings, and completed work in order. Start with the records you already keep, then choose an app that makes them easier to find and use.

sections.title: Put a date and a grow on each observation
sections.body: Record what you fed, what the plant looked like, and what changed. In GrowPathAI, journal entries and supported tool results connect to a grow timeline so you can review the sequence instead of searching a camera roll.

sections.title: Keep the next task near the record
sections.body: A journal tells you what happened; tasks help you remember what to check next. GrowPathAI connects grow records with feeding, watering, scheduled work, and contextual AI help. Review suggestions before acting; AI is not a diagnosis guarantee.

sections.title: Check what Free actually includes
sections.body: GrowPathAI Free includes 1 tracked grow, 1 plant, and 5 AI credits each week, with no payment card required. Compare the limits against the number of plants you want to record; a free account is not unlimited usage.
sections.linkLabel: Read plan limits and export answers

sections.title: Choose where your records live
sections.body: GrowPathAI is cloud-backed. If local-first records and a one-time license are important to you, compare GrowTrackr. If a mobile grow journal is your priority, also compare Grow with Jane. Try your everyday logging and export tasks before choosing.

sections.title: Keep a record you can take with you
sections.body: Check the actual export, not just whether a product says it has one. GrowPathAI supports timeline and report exports where your plan and role allow them, plus account-export requests in Profile privacy controls. A timeline PDF is not a complete original-photo backup.
sections.linkLabel: Compare Grow with Jane and GrowPathAI

vs/growtrackr.title: GrowPathAI and GrowTrackr: cloud-backed or local-first?
vs/growtrackr.intro: Prefer installed software with local records and a one-time paid license? GrowTrackr is worth considering. Prefer a cloud-backed journal connected to sharing, courses, and team workspaces? Compare GrowPathAI's limits and try the tasks you actually use.

sections.title: GrowTrackr: installed, local-first records
sections.body: GrowTrackr currently advertises Pro at $59 once, rather than a monthly or annual subscription. Free includes 5 grows, 50 plants, and 1 space with a banner ad. Its pricing page lists Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android, plus optional Pro device sync. Check its checkout for current currency, price, and terms.

sections.title: GrowPathAI: records connected to other work
sections.body: Free includes 1 grow, 1 plant, and 5 weekly AI credits. Pro Grower is $10/month or $100/year for 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 weekly AI credits. Commercial and Facility plans add separate brand or team workflows. GrowPathAI is not an offline-only journal.

sections.title: Both offer AI with grow context
sections.body: GrowTrackr advertises Growmie, photo diagnosis, and journal analysis, with cloud-provider or local Ollama options. GrowPathAI attaches relevant records when you start AI from supported grow, plant, log, or photo workflows. Neither approach guarantees a correct answer.

sections.title: Local by default does not mean every action is offline
sections.body: GrowTrackr describes local storage by default; optional sync, cloud AI, and vendor-cloud integrations involve connections. Its first license activation needs internet. Review the settings you enable. GrowPathAI's Privacy page describes its cloud processing and data rights.

sections.title: Try the export before committing a season of records
sections.body: GrowTrackr's logging guide describes run reports in PDF, CSV, or Markdown. GrowPathAI offers supported timeline/report exports and an account-export request. Check whether the output contains the records and photos you need; neither statement here promises a complete original-media backup.

sections.title: Choose the workflow, not a winner's badge
sections.body: A one-time license can suit a different budget from a subscription. GrowTrackr also advertises hardware integrations and timelapses; it is not simply a notes app. Compare the tasks you will actually use. This comparison is written by GrowPathAI, not an independent review.

vs/grow-with-jane.title: GrowPathAI and Grow with Jane: choose your grow journal
vs/grow-with-jane.intro: Both organize grow records and offer contextual AI assistance. Try the logging workflow, check the limits, and test an export before you commit a whole grow.

sections.body: Grow with Jane offers plant and environment tracking, public growlogs, growing guides, and community discussions. Its website links to iOS and Android downloads. Check the app store for current subscription prices in your country; we have not verified a single universal price.

sections.title: GrowPathAI: journal, tasks, and connected workspaces
sections.body: Free includes 1 grow, 1 plant, and 5 weekly AI credits. Pro Grower is $10/month or $100/year for 10 grows, 50 plants, and 100 weekly AI credits. Commercial and Facility plans add separate brand or team workflows.

sections.title: Does only GrowPathAI use grow history with AI?
sections.body: No. Jane AI also accepts selected plants, environments, photos, and supported growlog context. GrowPathAI likewise attaches relevant grow history when you start from supported records. Neither AI system guarantees a correct diagnosis.

sections.title: Can I keep an export?
sections.body: Grow with Jane's support discussion describes browser Print → Save as PDF as a growlog workaround, rather than a complete in-app export. GrowPathAI has supported timeline/report exports and account-export requests. Test whether the output includes the photos and records you need.
sections.linkLabel: Source: Grow with Jane export discussion

sections.title: Who owns my records?
sections.body: GrowPathAI's Terms say your content remains yours and its Privacy page describes cloud processing and account-export requests. Review each service's privacy terms separately before uploading sensitive records. This is GrowPathAI's comparison, not an independent review.

founder.homeMention: Built by Jay, host of Exploring the Growing Universe.
founder.homeStory: I wanted practical tools, grow records, education and community in one place, instead of scattering a grow's history across ten apps.
founder.businessLine: GrowPathAI is a brand of Triplebag Genetics, LLC, registered in Maryland.
founder.story: I built GrowPathAI because I wanted social software and AI to empower the people using them, not feed arguments or turn their interests into someone else's product. I wanted a place for growers: community alongside practical tools of the trade. My longer-term goal is to bring that same approach to other industries. GrowPathAI is where I'm starting.
founder.historyNote: In Jay's words, adapted from his founder story and clarifications supplied October 4, 2026. The dates describe remembered milestones, not a confirmed first-concept date or a public product launch. Future ambitions below are not a list of shipped features.

historySections.title: June 2025 — learning by building
historySections.body: GrowPathAI did not start as a gardening app. In June 2025, I started experimenting with applications around the Pi Network ecosystem: marketplaces, jobs, education and payments. One early idea was a store for soil, nutrients, seeds and growing equipment that could accept Pi. That led me into payment gateways and how software systems fit together. I was learning how far AI-assisted development could take one person with an idea.

historySections.title: August 4, 2025 — returning to growing
historySections.body: I remember August 4, 2025 as a milestone in GrowPathAI taking shape, though I may have had the original concept earlier. I do not have a confirmed date for that first idea. Growing was something I knew from years of experimenting, making mistakes and studying plants. I wanted more than a static calendar saying what to do in week one, two or three. Two plants of the same cultivar can behave differently. The plant and its environment change the plan.

historySections.title: The original idea: follow the plant
historySections.body: My starting point was the idea of a choose-your-own-adventure book. I later turned that idea into GrowPathAI: a growing system where the next step depends on the plant and what has happened so far. Jorge Cervantes' LAWNS framework — Light, Air, Water, Nutrients and Substrate — was one inspiration for GrowPathAI. GrowPathAI takes its own approach; it does not use his framework. I wanted growers to bring photos, observations, watering, feeding and environmental records together over time, so AI could help explain patterns in that particular grow. The aim was to help people understand their own information and decide what to do next.

historySections.title: Tools need people, too
historySections.body: Growing has always been a community activity. People teach each other, compare techniques, ask questions and show their plants. I wanted practical tools, grow records, education and community in one place, instead of scattering a grow's history across ten apps. Start personal. Learn. Track. Improve. Share. Scale. The platform should grow with the person using it.

historySections.title: Make the person more capable
historySections.body: My background is architecture, construction, design and growing, not a traditional software career. I learned by building, with plenty of wrong turns and things rebuilt along the way. I don't want technology that quietly profiles people, speaks for them or publishes without their knowledge. AI should explain, assist and suggest. When something consequential happens, the person should stay involved in the decision.

historySections.title: The longer-term vision
historySections.body: I'd like to bring this approach to other industries: tools, education, community and AI built around the work people actually do. That's a future ambition, not something GrowPathAI already delivers outside growing. GrowPathAI is where I'm starting. Give people better tools, better information and a way to connect with each other. Use AI to empower the person holding the tool.

pricingFaq.title: Is Free a trial that turns into a bill?
pricingFaq.body: No. The Free plan has no subscription charge and does not require a payment card. It includes 1 tracked grow, 1 tracked plant, and 5 AI credits per week. A paid plan is a separate checkout choice. Plan terms and limits may change; see the Terms of Service.

pricingFaq.title: What does one AI credit buy?
pricingFaq.body: A standard AI assistant request uses 1 credit and a standard plant diagnosis uses 3. For example, Free's 5 weekly credits can cover 5 assistant requests, or 1 diagnosis and 2 assistant requests. Other AI workflows can have different costs; check the displayed cost before starting. Credits reset weekly, not monthly. Facility work uses the Facility's shared pool, not 2,000 credits for each team member.

pricingFaq.title: What happens when I reach a limit?
pricingFaq.body: An AI action needs enough credits before it can run; wait for the next weekly reset or review the available plan options. Grow and plant limits restrict adding more tracked records. They do not mean that existing records are automatically deleted. You do not have to buy a plan just to keep your account.

pricingFaq.title: Do I still own my photos and grow records?
pricingFaq.body: Yes. Under our Terms, you retain ownership of the content you add. GrowPathAI is a cloud service, not an offline-only local notebook. We store and process records through service providers to run the app. Review Privacy for how account information, photos, and other records are handled.

pricingFaq.title: Can I take my records with me?
pricingFaq.body: Supported timeline and report screens provide exports where your plan and role allow them. You can also request an account export from Profile's privacy controls. These are different export paths: do not assume a timeline PDF is a complete backup of every original photo or every account record.

pricingFaq.title: How do payments and cancellation work?
pricingFaq.body: Paid checkout is handled by Stripe; GrowPathAI does not store full card numbers. Manage an existing subscription from Account Billing. Review the cancellation effective date before confirming. Annual prices are charged in one payment, not monthly installments. Refund eligibility follows the terms shown for the purchase; we do not promise an unconditional money-back guarantee.

pricingFaq.title: Which plan should I choose?
pricingFaq.body: Start Free for one grow and one plant. Pro Grower adds room for 10 grows and 50 plants at $10/month or $100/year. Choose Commercial for brand and storefront workflows, or Facility for room-based team operations. Facility credits are shared within that workspace. These are different workflow plans, not a promise of unlimited seats, usage, or device integrations.

pricingValueAnchor: At the 10-grow plan limit, $10/month works out to $1 per tracked grow per month.
pricingAlternativeAnchor: Compare $10/month with what you spend on separate notebooks and journal apps: keep up to 10 grows' notes, feeds and photos together. Your savings depend on the tools you replace.
scope: GrowPathAI keeps records and helps you review them. It is not an automatic grow controller, a guarantee of plant health or yield, or a substitute for professional advice. Ordinary public storefronts do not process cannabis sales. If you only want a photo feed for bud shots, this is probably more structure than you need.
